name: Natalia Olivia Jackson
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Natalie Jackson as an author of “Human habitat modelling in New Zealand”; “Web mapping of demographic diversity”.
The GeoCart programme and proceedings use “Natalie Jackson” and “Natalia Olivia Jackson” for the same human-habitat modelling contribution.
